playlists = []

    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='')
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_playlists', len(playlists))

# Collect unique song ids across playlists
playlist_song_ids_union = set()
for p in playlists:
    for sid in p.get('song_ids', []):
        playlist_song_ids_union.add(sid)

playlist_song_ids_union = sorted(playlist_song_ids_union)
print('unique_playlist_song_ids', len(playlist_song_ids_union))
print('playlist_song_ids_union', playlist_song_ids_union)

# Determine release years for these songs
song_release_year = {}
missing_release = []
for sid in playlist_song_ids_union:
    info = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    rd = info.get('release_date')
    if not rd:
        missing_release.append(sid)
        continue
    song_release_year[sid] = int(str(rd)[:4])

print('songs_with_release_year', len(song_release_year))
print('missing_release_count', len(missing_release))
print('missing_release_ids', missing_release)

remove_from_playlists_set = {sid for sid, y in song_release_year.items() if y < 2021}
print('remove_from_playlists_count', len(remove_from_playlists_set))
print('remove_from_playlists_song_ids', sorted(remove_from_playlists_set))

# Build explicit filtered list of (playlist_id, song_id) to remove
removal_pairs = []
for p in playlists:
    pid = p['playlist_id']
    for sid in p.get('song_ids', []):
        if sid in remove_from_playlists_set:
            removal_pairs.append((pid, sid))

# De-duplicate pairs

    library_song_ids.extend([s['song_id'] for s in page])
    page_index += 1
library_song_ids = sorted(set(library_song_ids))

library_song_release_year = {}
